description.value: DQ Grill & Chill is a Dairy Queen franchise in Chilliwack offering burgers, chicken, and ice cream treats including the iconic Blizzard. The Grill & Chill format includes dine-in seating alongside drive-through and takeout service. It sits along DeLair Road and would be a familiar, reliable stop for a touring cyclist needing a quick meal or cold treat.
